question: Use `tests/qa/testcase.py`, class `TestReplaceStringParamsLoopTotalIterationsQA`. The class contains 15 test methods (`test_replace_string_params_loop_total_iterations_case_01` through `..._case_15`). Each test method instantiates `cfnlint.template.transforms._language_extensions._Transform()` and performs a sequence of `t._replace_string_params(s, params)` invocations with varying `s` strings (some containing `${name}`/`&{name}` placeholders, some not) and varying `params` dicts (sizes 0 to 12, sometimes with dict-valued entries). The 15 sequences differ in number of calls (1 to 12) and per-call shapes. QUESTION: how many times does the for-loop at line 210 of `src/cfnlint/template/transforms/_language_extensions.py` (`for k, v in params.items():` inside `_Transform._replace_string_params`) iterate its BODY during ONE such test method's execution? (The answer is invariant -- every one of the 15 test methods produces the same iteration count.) Return the answer under the field `total_iterations`. Reasoning rules to simulate (PER TEST): (a) Each call begins by evaluating `re.search(r"(\$|&){[a-zA-Z0-9\.:]+}", s)` at line 206. If `s` has NO `${name}` or `&{name}` substring, the function returns `(True, s)` at line 207 BEFORE entering the for-loop -- the call contributes 0 iterations regardless of `len(params)`. (b) Otherwise the for-loop at line 210 iterates EXACTLY `len(params)` times -- one body execution per key in `params.items()`. (c) Empty `params = {}` with a pattern-bearing `s` passes the regex guard but the loop has nothing to iterate -- the call contributes 0 iterations. (d) The intra-body `if isinstance(v, dict)` at line 211 (which replaces dict values with an md5 hex prefix at lines 212-216) does NOT alter the iteration count. A param whose value is a dict still counts as exactly one iteration. (e) Whether a param's key actually appears in `s` is irrelevant to iter count -- the body's two `re.sub` calls at lines 217 and 218 just make zero substitutions for absent keys, but the iteration still counts. (f) The total per test is the SUM over all calls of `len(params)` for calls whose `s` contained a pattern, PLUS 0 for calls whose `s` did not.
